text:
maya (prod-designer): Quick win from usability: users read the stacked preview bars as progress. Can we make the visualization lighter and the labels clearer?
leo (frontend): Agree. Proposal: slim bars to 6px, move percent to right column, and keep an invisible 44px drag hit area.
pat (pm): Validation copy is weak: currently 'Overlap'. Suggest: 'Overlap: "Canary" overlaps "Default". Make targets exclusive or lower priority.'
hugo (engineer): Implementation notes: keep stable rule IDs for memoized percent calc. Use `Math.round((w/total)*100)`. Also preserve focus on reorder by saving focused rule id before reflow.
a11y-bot: :warning: Contrast fail on small label text with accent-green. Use neutral-900 or accent-700. Also ensure keyboard focus ring remains visible when preview overlay toggles.
maya (prod-designer): I'll update Figma with token swaps and an info tooltip that explains the percent formula and a toggle for 'percent | samples'.
leo (frontend): I'll prototype CSS vars: `--preview-bar-h:6px; --preview-handle-hit:44px; --preview-gap:10px;` Will include keyboard fixes in the PR.
pat (pm): Can someone own final microcopy? I'll review once comps are in.
hugo (engineer): I can pair for 20m after standup to validate IDs and aria-live placement.
maya (prod-designer): Thanks team 496 I'll post updated frames and a short copy list here when ready.
